name: Conntour
all_locations: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
long_description:
Conntour enables organizations to query thousands of security cameras using natural language.

Users can search past footage (“Find a man with tattoos on his left arm”), configure real-time alerts (“Notify me if someone climbs over the wall”), and extract data (“How many pickup trucks entered yesterday?”).

Unlike traditional video analytics limited to pre-defined parameters (like a weapon, bag, or license plate), Conntour supports unlimited, highly specific scenarios described in plain language. This enables a single human to monitor thousands of cameras.

Matan (CEO) worked with security cameras for years, leading video surveillance in the Israeli Military. Tomer (CTO) is a second-time founder and former director of engineering. Our team also includes computer vision experts from Israel’s elite 8200 intelligence unit and former top officials from the Mossad.

Conntour is backed by General Catalyst, selected for the first-ever Palantir fellowship, and advised by Bob Flores, former CTO at the CIA.
one_liner: AI to monitor thousands of security cameras.

launches.title: Conntour: Ask Security Cameras Anything
launches.tagline: Search and monitor thousands of video feeds with simple text queries
launches.body:
**TL;DR**: **Conntour lets governments and corporates query their security cameras.**

Users can search past footage (“Find a man with a blue backpack”), set alerts (“Notify me if someone climbs over the wall”), and extract data (“How many vehicles entered yesterday?”).

In just a few months, Conntour secured the Singapore government as a paying customer.

https://www.tella.tv/video/cm6k221g4000f0bl1csynd0p1/view

# **Who we’re building it for:**

Conntour targets organizations with thousands of security cameras. That includes governments (military, police, intelligence) and businesses (corporates, retail, industrial companies). These teams can’t manage so many cameras and it leads to huge losses - money, legal violations, and even human lives.

# **The Problem with existing solutions:**

They offer low customization, as they’re limited to pre-defined parameters (like shirt color or license plate number). This **lack of flexibility** causes missed critical events, too many false alarms, and countless hours wasted on manual footage review. Conntour solves this by offering **unlimited flexibility** through natural language queries - just ask anything.

# **Team:**

Matan (CEO) led a military video surveillance unit - leveraging security cameras to save lives. Tomer (CTO) is a second-time founder and former director of engineering.

We’ve known each other for 13 years, first meeting in the special forces during our mandatory military service. Since then, we’ve studied together and tackled many challenges side by side.
